scenarios.prompt: A launched capsule crosses a thin wall distance in one tick and then reaches a sloped floor. Define collision-safe body motion, wall response and landing publication.

criteria.ownership: Owns collision-safe body traversal; trajectory intent remains with knockback-launch.
criteria.collision: Uses the declared gameplay proxy and sweep/continuous test appropriate to the target rather than teleporting.
criteria.evidence: Tests thin walls, corners, slopes and floor with contact normals and reproducible landing ticks.
